svg.aria-label: Results: the pre-registered test failed, 1.04 times the size rule against 2 times required. Beyond size, the graph adds 0.09 to 0.23 AUC (exploratory, defined afterwards). Agents reading the graph through Relate picked 9 of 30 pairs that came true, where chance expects 1.5 and the graph alone got 10.
